brief:
Ahead of local elections, South Africans are drawing connections between domestic policy and the conflict in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. Voters say municipal candidates' positions on Palestine represent broader questions about the country's values and international obligations.

The timing of the ballot coincides with sustained public attention to developments in occupied Palestinian territories, shaping how some South Africans evaluate local leadership on foreign policy grounds.

title: South Africans link Gaza solidarity to municipal election stakes
